name: pptx-author
description: Build new PowerPoint decks from scratch with python-pptx: slides, layouts, charts, speaker notes.
body: Use when the user wants a NEW .pptx deck created. Start from a layout, add slides one at a time, save to disk. Not for editing an existing deck.

name: pptx-edit
description: Edit an existing .pptx: replace text, reorder or delete slides, swap images, fix fonts.
body: Use when a .pptx already exists and needs changes. Open it, locate the shapes, change them in place, save a copy.

name: xlsx
description: Create, read and edit Excel workbooks: formulas, formatting, charts, pivot-style summaries.
body: Use for any .xlsx task. openpyxl for cell work, pandas for bulk data. Always keep formulas live rather than pasting values.

name: docx
description: Create and edit Word documents: headings, tables, tracked changes, comments.
body: Use for .docx files. python-docx for structure; preserve styles; tracked changes need the XML path.

name: pdf
description: Read, split, merge, fill forms in and extract tables from PDF files.
body: Use for .pdf input or output. pypdf for pages, pdfplumber for tables, form filling via field names.

name: ros2-launch
description: Write and debug ROS 2 launch files: nodes, parameters, remappings, composable containers.
body: Use when a launch.py or launch.xml needs writing or fixing. Covers IncludeLaunchDescription, parameters from YAML, namespaces.

name: ros2-tf
description: Diagnose and fix ROS 2 tf2 transform trees: missing frames, extrapolation errors, static transforms.
body: Use for tf2 errors: frame does not exist, lookup would require extrapolation, disconnected trees. view_frames, tf2_echo.

name: gazebo-sim
description: Build and run Gazebo simulation worlds, sensors and robot models for ROS 2.
body: Use to create SDF worlds, spawn robots, add lidar or camera sensors, bridge topics with ros_gz_bridge.

name: git-commit
description: Write a Conventional Commits message for the staged changes and commit.
body: Use when the user asks to commit. Inspect the staged diff, pick the type and scope, write an imperative subject.

name: pr-review
description: Review a pull request diff for bugs, missing tests and risky changes, and post findings.
body: Use when asked to review a PR or branch. Read the diff, run the tests, rank findings by severity.

name: tdd
description: Test-driven development: write a failing test, make it pass, refactor.
body: Use when the user wants a feature built test-first or says red-green-refactor.

name: debug-python
description: Find the root cause of a failing Python test or traceback by bisecting and instrumenting.
body: Use when a Python test fails or a traceback needs explaining. Reproduce, minimise, bisect, fix the cause not the symptom.

name: docker
description: Write Dockerfiles and compose files, and debug container builds and networking.
body: Use for Dockerfile, docker compose, image size, multi-stage builds and container networking issues.

name: k8s-deploy
description: Deploy and troubleshoot workloads on Kubernetes: manifests, Helm charts, rollouts, crash loops.
body: Use for kubectl, Helm, CrashLoopBackOff, rollout status, resource limits.

name: terraform
description: Write and plan Terraform for cloud infrastructure, and fix state or provider errors.
body: Use for .tf files, terraform plan/apply errors, state moves, provider version pins.

name: sql-query
description: Write and optimise SQL queries against a relational database, and explain query plans.
body: Use when the user needs a query written, a slow query sped up, or EXPLAIN output read.

name: label-printer
description: Print shipping and asset labels on the office thermal label printer, and encode RFID tags.
body: Use to send ZPL to the thermal printer, print asset tags, encode RFID EPCs, troubleshoot VOID labels.

name: calendar
description: Read and create events on the user's calendar, find free slots, send invites.
body: Use to schedule meetings, check availability, create or move events.

name: email-draft
description: Draft and send email from the user's mailbox, with attachments.
body: Use to compose, reply to, or send email on the user's behalf.

name: slack-post
description: Post messages and files to the team's Slack channels, and read recent threads.
body: Use to post an announcement, reply in a thread, or summarise a channel.

name: jira
description: Create, update and search Jira issues and sprints.
body: Use for Jira tickets: create a bug, move an issue, query a sprint, add comments.

name: diagram
description: Draw architecture, sequence and data-flow diagrams as SVG or Mermaid.
body: Use when the user wants a system drawn: boxes and arrows, sequence diagrams, state machines.

name: frontend-design
description: Design polished web interfaces: layout, typography, color, components.
body: Use when building or restyling a web page or component and it should look designed, not default.

name: web-scrape
description: Crawl a website and extract structured data into JSON or CSV.
body: Use to scrape listings, product pages or tables from a site, following pagination.

name: data-viz
description: Make charts and dashboards from data: bar, line, scatter, heatmap, with good defaults.
body: Use whenever a chart or plot is needed, in any library.

name: security-audit
description: Audit code for security vulnerabilities: injection, secrets, auth flaws, unsafe deserialisation.
body: Use for a security review of a codebase or a change.

name: release-notes
description: Write release notes and a changelog entry from the commits since the last tag.
body: Use when preparing a release: group commits by type, write user-facing notes.

name: dependency-upgrade
description: Upgrade a project's dependencies safely: bump versions, read changelogs, fix breakages.
body: Use to update packages, resolve version conflicts, or clear a vulnerability advisory.
